ns2:course.label: Professional Internship
ns2:course.description: Summer, part-time, or other professional-level employment in the field of planning, usually in an area of concentration; exposure to the social, political, and institutional setting in which planning operates; and full documentation of internship activities required. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
